# proxmox_pools (Data Source)

Lists Proxmox VE pools from `/pools`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "proxmox_pools" "all" {}
```
